**My pick for a 2kWh portable power station for an RV under $900 is the <Entity category="product" value="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO"/>**, especially if value for money is your priority.

The October 2026 RV power station rankings place it first in the 1,500–2,999Wh category, with a built-in TT-30 RV outlet, LiFePO4 battery, and expandable capacity. <Cite ref="turn307738view0"/>

## Best options compared

| Model | Listed price | Capacity | AC output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO** | **$676.16** | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| OUPES Mega 2 Pro | $699 | 2,048Wh | 2,500W |
| Dabbsson DBS2100 Pro | $799 | 2,150Wh | 2,400W |
| Renogy PowerStation 2000 | $799 | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| BLUETTI AC200L | $854.05 with code | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |

<caption>Prices from the supplied search results, primarily checked in October 2026. Availability and checkout prices may change.</caption>

## Why the Growatt wins

- **Excellent value:** approximately $0.33 per Wh.
- **RV-ready:** built-in TT-30 outlet for connecting your RV shore-power cord.
- **Expandable:** useful if you eventually need longer off-grid runtime.
- **Enough output for essentials:** refrigerators, lighting, water pumps, and many small kitchen appliances.

<text weight="medium">One important limitation:</text> A 2,400W inverter supplies approximately 20A at 120V, not the full 30A that an RV shore-power connector might suggest. Running a rooftop air conditioner alongside other high-draw appliances can overload it.

## When I'd choose something else

  <AsyncImage query="BLUETTI AC200L portable power station product white background" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="136px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L"/> — $854.05 with promo code**

    A strong alternative with a 2,048Wh LiFePO4 battery, 2,400W output, 30A RV connection and up to 1,200W solar input.

    <text color="secondary" size="xs">Code: `AFF5OFF` · Listed regular price $899</text>

    <Link url="https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l" title="View BLUETTI deal"/>
  </box>
</row>

<row align="start" gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 portable power station product" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="136px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="Jackery Explorer 2000 v2"/> — under $900 at some retailers**

    A better choice when portability matters. It weighs approximately 39 lb and was recommended by OutdoorGearLab for extended off-grid camping. The official Jackery listing in the supplied results was $999, so confirm the discount before buying.

    <Link url="https://www.jackery.com/products/jackery-explorer-2000-v2-portable-power-station" title="Jackery product details"/>
  </box>
</row>

**Bottom line:** Get the **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO at $676.16** for the strongest RV-focused value. Choose the **BLUETTI AC200L** if its solar-input capability and particular feature set better suit your setup.

One question would change my recommendation: **Do you need to run your RV's rooftop air conditioner, or mainly the fridge, lights, water pump, and electronics?**
